limitations: One predeclared contemporaneous control/candidate pair, not a repeatability or percentile estimate.
Control and candidate use separate GitHub-hosted workers; CPU/image cohorts are recorded, but shared resource variability remains.
Native wall and runner-minute comparisons apply to these complete Native workflows, not to differently scoped full repository workflow cohorts.
Candidate applicable-check event envelope must be reported separately; control did not repeat GDExtension, Palette or Documentation.
Full job accounting includes successful, failed, cancelled and skipped outcomes; skipped jobs receive zero execution time rather than artificial timestamp intervals.
Command elapsed receipts separate actual test/build work from setup and artifact overhead. They do not separate every compiler invocation from each test within a make target.
The sanitizer move removes an actual serial dependency. Its predecessor duration is an observed scheduling opportunity, not an added independent wall-time saving.
The long-family priority can delay the first completed short family; admission feedback and first functional family result are reported separately.
Memory reported as direct_process_only is wrapper memory and cannot be interpreted as aggregate compiler or native-test peak RSS.
performance_assessment: Meaningful speedup is not established: only 25 seconds / 1.1121% shorter elapsed, 4m58s more runner time, and a 209-second later first completed native family, with heterogeneous critical CPU models.
status_scope: Source, custody, complete accounting and canonical qualification replay passed; this is not a performance acceptance verdict.
